evidence.title: Test-Time Adaptation for ECG Classification via SQI-Gated Self-Training and Beat-Rhythm Consistency

summary: Researchers introduced a test‑time adaptation technique that employs signal‑quality‑indexed (SQI) gated self‑training combined with beat‑rhythm consistency constraints to improve electrocardiogram (ECG) classification. The approach dynamically adjusts models during inference, yielding higher diagnostic performance on noisy and diverse ECG recordings.
title: New Test-Time Adaptation Method Boosts ECG Classification Accuracy
